title: A top bar and a collapsible sidebar frame every workspace
body:
decade's chrome today is a status line on the bottom row (`Layout::draw` in `src/panes.rs`: workspace name, focused pane, zoom, the palette hint), the Ctrl bar over each pane, the palette, and the Super+Tab picker. The status line has no hierarchy and no truncation, and nothing on screen shows that other workspaces exist.

## Proposal

- A top bar that is always shown replaces the status line. On the left: the workspace's name, its tabs, and a button for a new tab. On the right: counts of agent states across all workspaces and a palette button.
- A sidebar on the left lists every workspace, sorted by agent state, with a mark for each state. A click switches to the workspace. Super+B collapses it to a strip of marks, or hides it.
- The Ctrl bar stays as the per-pane overlay, and the picker stays as the visual grid.
- The top bar and sidebar are chrome under the text rule in CLAUDE.md, so picker thumbnails leave their text out.
- The sidebar's collapsed state is saved with the workspaces.

## Open

- The exact contents of the top bar beyond the items above.
- Whether the collapsed sidebar is a strip of marks or nothing.
close_reason: Landed in 50d4fec. The sidebar's collapsed state is not saved yet; it waits for the version 2 save format that workspace tabs (decade-1ba809) bring. Super+B and Super+A were added to ~/.config/hypr/decade.lua.
